group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: A friend's face on Mark Twain

turns.text: Swap my friend's face (first photo) onto the Mark Twain portrait (second photo). Keep everything else about the portrait: the white hair, the suit, the pose, the black and white.

tests: A plain face swap: does it reach for swap_face_in_photo or prompt an edit model, and which keeps the portrait?

answer_sheet.Whose face: The man in the first photo.

must_haves: The face is the friend's from the first photo (the broad smile, the dark eyebrows), not Twain's.
The white swept-back hair, moustache or not, the light suit and the pose are the portrait's.
The picture stays black and white.
The framing matches the original portrait.
